source: #48 (research/s3e-bitstream/README.md, "Rebuilding the database"): three CLB switches that the rebuild's experiments (measure-db.sh) measured once only, each with a side effect of the removal: Y2 -> E2BEG7 (pips/pd-dcm: bitgen also changed the slice's LUT and output settings whose only route was removed; the 4 bits left after stripLutRuns are of frame 1, not of the switch box), W2BEG4 -> BY3 (pips/pd-bufgmux: a cleared bit, the pin's input multiplexer falling back), OMUX_N10 -> BX2 (pips/pd-srl: the column bit 11,33 shared with another switch of the design, among the batch's unexplained bits). The values of the earlier experiments, which fit the encoding of the other switches into the same pin (one row bit of frames 11 / 12 per pin source), are kept.
